gold_review.explanation: Reward requires compiling OpenSCAD via an external `openscad` binary (auto-downloaded 2021 bundle); in our VM every compile — including the reference program itself sent raw (extract_scad falls back to whole text) — silently returned None so compiled=0 for all.
gold_review.evidence: cad_env.py:18 'Requires the openscad binary on PATH'; :890-897 subprocess failure → None; :942-943 mesh None → reward 0; gold_raw.log compiled r1=[0.0]*5
